origin: Additional source-only coordinator referral during benchmark application, after v1–v3 proposal seals and while independent review of the ten earlier findings was underway. Those completed checks remain scoped work; finalization is held for this exact new delta. No candidate information supplied or inspected; not fresh source-first discovery.
conclusion: The source reports four deaths and about forty injuries during the Grenoble riots and separately states that troops were bombarded from rooftops. It does not identify the actions causing the reported casualties. The retained distinction asserts rooftop projectiles caused deaths/injuries, and its copied wording appears in the main, source-treatment and facet meanings. A stance saying not every casualty was assigned to rooftops does not cure that positive unsupported attribution. This is an incomplete implementation of an already explicit earlier repair, not a newly discovered event or changed priority.
proposed_handling: Replace only action-specific casualty causation with event-level co-occurrence throughout the one subject; make the uncertainty explicit in main/treatment/facet stances and retained qualification. Neutralize the parallel evidence wording that makes crowds the agent leaving people dead. Preserve the valid event, exile context, rooftop attacks, totals, local significance, optional priority, named routes, evidence IDs/classes/pages and sole linked task.

before_whole_parent.label: Day of Tiles at Grenoble
